title: Bethesda Sets Release Date For Massive Fallout 4 'Creations' Update On Xbox Consoles
summary:
Series X and S are getting up to 100GB storage!

If you're a fan of playing Fallout 4 on Xbox consoles, you're probably aware that the storage limit for Creations — modded content that you can add to your game — has always been extremely low on Xbox One, Series X and Series S.

That's all about to change with a massive update on May 27th though, as Bethesda has confirmed that Creations storage will jump from 2GB to a whopping 100GB (!) on Xbox Series X and S on that date, allowing for not only more space to download extra content, but also for "larger, more ambitious creations" on Xbox consoles.

title: Forza Horizon 6 Smashes Concurrent Player Record For Xbox Game Studios On Steam
summary:
Finishing first place.

Less than a week ago, we spoke about how popular Forza Horizon 6 was proving to be in early access on Steam - and to no-one's surprise, that's continued with the full release. In fact, Playground's new racer has now become the most-played Xbox Game Studios title on Steam in terms of concurrent players; a massive achievement for the team.

Taking a look the very useful SteamDB stats page, Forza Horizon 6 managed a peak player count of 273,148 on launch day, May 19th. With that number, it's shot to the top of the list for concurrent players on an Xbox Game Studios title - beating out the previous record holder — Halo Infinite — by about 500 players.

According to the well-connected journalist, PlayStation Studios boss Herman Hulst confirmed the pivot in a recent meeting, as shared this week on social media:

While this news isn't directly relevant to us from a Microsoft perspective, we did think it could have significant ramifications for Xbox and Project Helix - and that's something that the folks over at Digital Foundry agree with us on. Liking what you've played so far?

With Forza Horizon 6 dominating a lot of the attention last week (and let's be honest, it's going to happen this week as well), we didn't get much chance to talk about Subnautica 2, which is now playable with Xbox Game Pass Ultimate.

To be honest, we didn't think it was going to release on time — this is a game that's suffered its fair share of behind-the-scenes controversy in recent months — but now that it's here, it feels like the reception has been pretty darn positive so far (aside from controversy about some of the wording included in the game's EULA).
